english.title: Fail to comply with a court order requiring the execution of work on / demolition of a dangerous building
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being the owner of a

(A)_[building or part of a building]_
(B)_[structure or part of a structure]_

at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) and having been made subject to an order under section 77(1) of the Building Act 1984 by **(..SPECIFY MAGISTRATES' COURT..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE OF ORDER..) to

(C)_[execute work, namely **(..SPECIFY WORK..)]_
(D)_[demolish that building and remove any rubbish resulting from the demolition]_
(E)_[demolish that structure and remove any rubbish resulting from the demolition]_
(F)_[demolish a dangerous part of the building, namely **(..SPECIFY PART OF BUILDING TO BE DEMOLISHED..) and remove any rubbish resulting from the demolition]_
(G)_[demolish a dangerous part of the structure, namely **(..SPECIFY PART OF STRUCTURE TO BE DEMOLISHED..) and remove any rubbish resulting from the demolition]_

by **(..SPECIFY DATE..), failed to comply with the order within the time specified in that **(..SPECIFY NATURE OF NON-COMPLIANCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 77(2) of the Building Act 1984.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: The local authority may also execute the order itself and recover expenses from person in default.
